options.name: address
options.description: The syslog server's IPv4 address or a fully qualified hostname. All existing syslog configurations will be removed when I(state=absent) and I(address=None).

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The url to the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API. Example https://prod-1.wahoo.acme.com:8443/devmgr/v2

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: components
options.description: The e-series logging components define the specific logs to transfer to the syslog server. At the time of writing, 'auditLog' is the only logging component but more may become available.

options.name: port
options.description: This is the port the syslog server is using.

options.name: protocol
options.description: This is the transmission protocol the syslog server's using to receive syslog messages.

options.name: ssid
options.description: The ID of the array to manage. This value must be unique for each array.

options.name: state
options.description: Add or remove the syslog server configuration for E-Series storage array. Existing syslog server configuration will be removed or updated when its address matches I(address). Fully qualified hostname that resolve to an IPv4 address that matches I(address) will not be treated as a match.

options.name: test
options.description: This forces a test syslog message to be sent to the stated syslog server. Only attempts transmission when I(state=present).
